फक्क r. 1st cl. (फक्कति)
 1. To creep, to move slowly or sluggishly.
 2. To
behave ill, to practise ill or improper conduct.

फक्किका f. (-का)
 1. A position, an assertion or argument, to be proved
or maintained.
 2. Logical exposition or elucidation.
 3. A sophism.
4. A trick.
 5.

. Fraud.
 E. फक्क् to move slowly, aff.
ण्वुल् टाप् ।
